developmentCorrections: A new base-controller regression first failed: backward offsets 3->1 became forward 1->3 and anchor affinity changed. Shared same-span preservation fixes it; list browser undo proves exact original endpoints/affinities.

Initial controller browser run passed Firefox but failed Chromium late-echo assumptions and WebKit synthetic target-range construction. A separate constructor probe verified the recorded differences. The harness uses standard terminal insertCompositionText and a temporary specific-event platform-method target fixture when the constructor omits ranges. Production event admission was not weakened.

Four focused unit failures were fixture errors: three omitted explicit null headingLevel on an additional paragraph item; one installed a spy after the adapter captured the generated method. Fixed the fixtures before the passing full run.
Typecheck caught missing narrowing for base/list queue ports. Explicit mode and instance checks preserve private queue ownership. Review also retained the existing cancellation history policy.
